changeSet.author: Arthur
changeSet.comment: Fix missing stop_times_id_seq sequence in production

sql.sql: DO $$ BEGIN IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_class WHERE relname = 'stop_times_id_seq' AND relkind = 'S') THEN CREATE SEQUENCE stop_times_id_seq START WITH 1 INCREMENT BY 1; PERFORM setval('stop_times_id_seq', COALESCE((SELECT MAX(id) FROM stop_times), 0) + 1, false); END IF; END $$;
